state.purpose: Synthetic native A2UI presentation evaluation. No real user, weather, images or conversation data.

forecast.request: Show the three-day forecast for Example City.
forecast.availableData: Verified weather observations and three daily high/low records, units, update time and public source URL are present.

images.request: Show a carousel of street-art images.
images.availableData: Five direct public HTTPS raster image URLs, descriptive captions and original source page URLs are present.

trend.availableData: Twelve labeled numeric observations and units are present.

overview.request: Give me an overview of weather and the monthly trend together.
overview.availableData: A verified forecast candidate and a separate verified numeric chart candidate are present.

explanation.request: Explain why the sky looks blue.
explanation.availableData: Explanatory prose only; no measurements or image URLs.

missing_evidence.request: Show the forecast and some images.
missing_evidence.availableData: No retrieved weather measurements, no direct image URLs, and no source links. Only the user request is available.

forecast.instructions: For case forecast, choose the most useful presentation from complete candidates supported by availableData. Never invent missing values or sources. A rich-looking request alone does not make data available.

criteria.Forecast: A weather request with existing verified weather data, units, update time and source.
criteria.ImageCarousel: An image browsing request with existing direct public HTTPS image URLs, captions and original source pages.
criteria.Chart: A numeric comparison or trend with existing labeled values and units.
criteria.Dashboard: An explicit combined overview with at least two independently valid rich component candidates.
criteria.Markdown: Prose is sufficient, evidence is missing, or no complete valid rich candidate is available.
